description: Only for feedback on a live website page. Ask layernote to confirm a fix: it re-screenshots the live page, re-runs the design comparison, and auto-resolves the feedback item when the underlying difference is gone. Prefer this over resolve_feedback for comparison-generated items — it proves the fix instead of trusting it. The deployed page must include your change first. Takes up to ~30 seconds. Comments on uploaded files cannot be verified this way.

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

name: verify_feedback
title: Verify a feedback fix
